title: SS27 Toddler Boys' Theme Colour Palettes
summary: Palettes for SS27 toddler boys themes.
research_period: Pitti Bimbo 103, Florence, 24-25 June 2026; Playtime Paris, 28-30 June 2026; analysis July to November 2026
markets: Premium and mid-market childrenswear, Europe-led fairs, global retail

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body: - Sailor collars, navy blues and nautical details appeared throughout Playtime Paris<sup>[1]</sup>

sections.heading: Palettes
sections.body:
| Theme | Lead | Accent |
|---|---|---|
| First Summer | Sand | navy and white |
| Little Harbour | Navy | white |

design_implications:
- Lead on most pieces.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.

sources.title: Playtime Paris SS27: where fashion met the spirit of a summer music festival
